output: One reason why comparison is much less easy in (1.1), or equivalently (1.9), than in diffusion equations, is that the region of \( t \leq i \), where the initial condition is transported along the characteristic line, has to be treated differently from the region of \( t > i \). Let us first recall the definition of super- and subsolutions for (1.9) as well as the comparison principle Proposition 2.1 for which we provide a new proof in the Appendix.
